evals.prompt: /bp 帮我做一个 AI 搜索产品官网，先别直接写页面，帮我整理成 START_HERE.md、design-spec.md、DESIGN.md，提示词有需要再导出。
evals.expected_output: The agent treats /bp as the short form of /briefpilot and routes the original request into the full BriefPilot design collaboration workflow.
expectations: The response states that /bp uses the same BriefPilot workflow as /briefpilot.
The original AI search landing page request is preserved.
The response points ordinary users to design-spec.md first and treats platform prompts as optional exports.
The agent does not invent a separate bp-only workflow.
The user-facing plan or output remains Chinese-first.

evals.prompt: /bp 我已经有生成结果，帮我按之前 brief 看看哪里要改
evals.expected_output: The agent routes a generated-result review request through BriefPilot's review-only result-review workflow.
expectations: The response asks for or uses the source brief package before formal review.
The response recognizes this as a generated-result review task.
The response mentions review-next-actions.md and does not edit files without explicit confirmation.
The response does not generate a new page directly.
